comparison.objective: Mount and secure an emergency-stop button in a keyed panel opening.
comparison.physical_skill: Keyed insertion plus rear-side locking-ring threading while holding the button seated.
comparison.success_condition: Button flush and aligned; ring tightened 165–185°; hands released and parts still for 1 s.
comparison.reason: The candidate tests bimanual many-body screening through apertures, selective retention, and loaded-screen reseating—not keyed insertion or threaded fastening.
